answer.book: Daneau's Geographia poetica (Leiden/Antwerp-style 1580 edition, printed by Stoer): a Latin verse geography of the whole world in four books (Europe, Africa, Asia, sea and islands), preceded by dedications to Sidney and an address to the reader and followed by an index.
